affected_items.title: Ensure 'Guest account status' is set to 'Disabled'
affected_items.description: The Guest account allows unauthenticated logon to the system.
affected_items.rationale: Guest enables anonymous access to the host.
affected_items.remediation: Disable the Guest account via local security policy.

affected_items.title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Domain: Firewall state' is set to 'On'
affected_items.description: The domain profile firewall is turned off.
affected_items.remediation: Enable Windows Firewall for the domain profile.

affected_items.title: Ensure 'Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts' is set to 'Enabled'
Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'
